summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Defined an evidence-grading scheme separating proven commercial deployment (G1 comparable LMIC, G2 higher-income only) from pilots (G3) and speculation (G4), and a candidate list of eleven technology families mapped to Nepal's sectors (remote sensing, drones, tissue culture, livestock genetics, hydropower digital monitoring, glacial-lake early warning, industrial robotics, additive manufacturing, molecular diagnostics, GenAI tools, batteries/e-mobility). No deployment evidence retrieved and no technology graded; only 4 marginal leads were located because the session's web-search budget was exhausted. All empirical items pending.

findings.claim: Evidence grading scheme (applies to every technology): G1 = proven commercial deployment at scale in low- or lower-middle-income settings comparable to Nepal, documented by tier 1-7 sources; G2 = proven commercial deployment only in high-income or upper-middle-income settings; G3 = pilots or trials with published evaluations; G4 = laboratory stage, projections or speculative claims. A grade requires retrieved evidence; ungraded items stay 'pending'.

Technology candidates were selected by matching Nepal's main sectors (agriculture, hydropower, tourism, remittance-dependent services, construction, light manufacturing, health) to technology families; the list is a research design, not an endorsement or a claim of relevance.

Evidence grade (G1-G4) for each candidate technology in specific.evidence_graded_technology_list, with deployment evidence (adoption counts, commercial users, evaluated productivity effects) and source.
findings.note: No deployment evidence retrieved in r1; only 4 marginal leads located before the session search budget was exhausted.

findings.claim: Nepal-specific adoption evidence for any G1/G2 technology (e.g. existing drone, remote-sensing, tissue-culture or early-warning deployments).
findings.period: Nepal fiscal year or calendar year as reported
findings.note: Requires Nepal ministry/NARC/ICIMOD documents; none located.

data_gaps: No deployment evidence located for any candidate technology. The session-wide WebSearch budget was exhausted during this round; data-source hosts and reference hosts (itu.int, nist.gov, wikipedia.org, arxiv.org) returned EGRESS_BLOCKED to WebFetch.

Required primary sources to locate in r2: IFR World Robotics (industrial robot installations by country), FAO/CGIAR evaluations of agricultural biotechnology in South Asia, peer-reviewed evaluations of medical-drone logistics in LMICs, ICIMOD documentation of glacial-lake early-warning systems in Nepal, IEA/IRENA hydropower digitalisation case studies, WHO diagnostics guidance.
Catalog lacks ids for IFR, CGIAR/ILRI and NARC (Nepal Agricultural Research Council).

assumptions.text: A technology is not treated as relevant to Nepal's growth path without G1 or G2 evidence; G3/G4 items are reported as speculative and carry no parameter into the model.
assumptions.basis_note: original label: 'task instruction to distinguish proven from speculative'

challenges.text: X37 has no located lead (as your data gaps note); 24E confirms it remains unresourced in r1 and cannot supply a tfp parameter until r2.
Search budget exhausted before 24E research; allocate searches or network access in r2. Add catalog ids for IFR, CGIAR/ILRI and NARC.
Red-team: any strategy that credits emerging technologies (e.g. robotics, biotech) with tfp gains should be checked against this grading; currently no technology has retrieved G1/G2 evidence.

uncertainty: Very high. No evidence retrieved; candidate list is design-only; leads are marginal and two are non-peer-reviewed preprints. Grades cannot be assigned in r1.
